kept.name: oh-my-hermes
kept.reason: Has a review-first project memory layer and deterministic routing for agents, so it's the closest catalogued agent-memory system to set beside your typed-record design.

kept.name: openspace
kept.reason: Keeps agent knowledge (skills) in SQLite with a version graph (DAG), lineage and quality metrics, and has skill discovery. That's a comparable structured, linked store with retrieval.

kept.name: trigger-tree
kept.reason: Measures whether agents find and follow markdown knowledge (CLAUDE.md), with checks for orphaned docs and router coverage. You could use it to evaluate retrieval quality in your system.

kept.name: dynamic-context-injection
kept.reason: Picks which markdown files enter the agent's context with shell logic instead of the model's judgment. It's a lesson that applies to deterministic retrieval and routing, and a baseline to compare search against.

kept.name: grill-with-docs
kept.reason: A markdown knowledge convention for agents (a CONTEXT.md glossary, a CONTEXT-MAP index, gated ADRs) that is written live during a session. It's close prior art for typed, linked records.
